query: What signals in a travel-expense description predict whether it will be declined?

per_column.name: asset_category_type
per_column.rationale: Values are soundly derived from ci/short_description (Dell laptop -> hardware_device, AWS -> cloud_service). However the query is about travel-expense declines; this categorises IT assets, largely redundant with existing category/ci fields and only loosely tied to the decline signal. Modest analytical leverage.

per_column.name: asset_purpose_signal
per_column.rationale: Mapping a Dell laptop to 'office_equipment' or AWS to 'server_infrastructure' is a warranted inference, but 'purpose' is not stated in the source text and largely restates asset_category_type (hardware->office_equipment near-deterministically), so it adds little independent signal and asserts purpose the text is silent on.

per_column.name: expense_source_indicator
per_column.rationale: Cleanly extracted from short_description phrasing ('Procurement of' -> procurement, 'Automated creation' -> automated_creation). This 'how the record originated' axis is plausibly predictive of decline behaviour and is well grounded.

per_column.name: departmental_context
per_column.rationale: An original 'department' column already exists, making this largely redundant. More critically, none of the sampled source texts contain department info, yet confident values (customer_support, sales) are asserted for rows whose text is silent on department -- unsupported specifics.

per_column.name: source_system_origin
per_column.rationale: Every sampled row is labelled 'internal_ticket_system' regardless of content (including an asset-management-style 'Automated creation' entry), and the source text gives no explicit originating system. Overlaps with the original source_id/type columns and the specific system is invented rather than read from text.

judge.rationale: The columns are asset-inventory categorisations that only weakly serve a query about what predicts travel-expense declines; expense_source_indicator is the most useful and best-grounded, while asset_purpose_signal is largely a restatement of asset_category_type. Groundedness is uneven: extraction-based columns (category, source_indicator) read the text soundly, but departmental_context and source_system_origin assert specifics (department, originating system) not present in the sampled source text and partly duplicate existing original columns.
